☼ The month in plain English

Think of reach as how many people walked past the window, and interactions as how many stopped to look in. In May, far more people walked by and more of them stopped — usually those rise apart, so growing both at once is the signal that the content is genuinely landing. The spike mid-month came from a reel that took off (the “autopilot” post), which pulled thousands of new viewers to the page who then explored more of the feed.

☼ What this means for HBG

The pattern is clear and repeatable: fun, team-forward reels travel furthest and bring in new people, while patio & spritz content converts that attention into saves and visits. Six of the top nine posts were summer / spritz themed — the seasonal storyline is working. A steady 1–2 strong reels per week keeps the discovery engine running.

☼ One honest note

Reach, views, and engagement all surged — the page is clearly healthier than it was in April. The one soft spot is net followers (−2): a handful more people unfollowed than followed. That’s normal in a month where reach expands fast and lots of new non-followers see the content before deciding to follow. The fix is simply consistency.

Who’s watching

Your audience,
in plain terms.

A loyal, local, mostly-45+ crowd that over-indexes toward women — concentrated right in Sonoma County. That means posts can speak directly to regulars and nearby locals who can actually walk in the door.

Instagram — gender

Roughly two-thirds women.

Instagram — age range

The core is 35–64 — an established, spending-age audience.

When they’re online

Most active 9am–6pm, peaking Tue–Thu. Best windows: Mon 3–9pm & Tue 6–9pm.

Facebook — top cities

Overwhelmingly local Sonoma County.
☼ What to do with this

Because the audience is local, 45+, and majority women, content that highlights the patio, daytime dining, community moments and approachable summer drinks resonates most. And since people are most active weekday daytime into early evening, scheduling posts Monday and Tuesday afternoons gives each one the best head start.

☼ The month in plain English

June was a record reach month — the brand was seen roughly 49,000 times, up two-thirds from May. The engine behind it was reels, led by a heartfelt welcome reel from Danya (her story of opening HBG) that resonated far and wide. That warm, personal storytelling powered a near-tripling of Facebook reach and kept Instagram’s audience deeply engaged — IG interactions actually rose even as views normalized. In short: authentic, founder-told content drove the month.

★ The reel that led the month

Danya’s warm welcome

June’s reach story starts here. We produced a dedicated reel with Danya sharing a heartfelt, personal welcome — the story of how she originally opened Healdsburg Bar & Grill and an open invitation to come visit. It was warm, human, and unmistakably HBG, and it struck a chord: this single reel became June’s top post by views and its biggest driver of new followers. Founder-told, face-forward storytelling like this is exactly what carried the month’s momentum — and it’s a repeatable play.

☼ What this means for HBG

Don’t be thrown by views easing a few percent — the more telling numbers are interactions up 15% and profile visits up 28%. May’s totals were inflated by one viral “autopilot” reel; strip that out and June is a stronger, more engaged month, led by Danya’s welcome reel above. The lesson is clear: warm, founder-told, face-forward content travels — and it brings new people who stick around. Keep a steady 1–2 of these a week.

☼ The honest read

This is the standout story of June: Facebook views nearly tripled to 30,877 with zero dollars in ad spend — all earned reach. Two things dipped — 3-second views and average watch time — but that’s expected when reach expands this fast: a flood of new people sample the content briefly before some stick. The takeaway is overwhelmingly positive: Facebook is now HBG’s biggest discovery engine, and it’s worth feeding.

July focus

Where we take it
from here.

June handed us a clear signal: Facebook is the breakout channel and Instagram’s audience is deepening. July is about pressing both advantages.

✓

Feed Facebook — it’s the breakout. 30.9K views on $0 ad spend. Keep sending it the same reels & patio content that carried June, and post consistently to compound the reach.

✓

Protect Instagram engagement. Views normalized but interactions rose 15% — the audience is more engaged, not less. Hold the 1–2 quality reels per week.

✓

Lead with the team — and the founder story. Danya’s warm-welcome reel was #1 by views (4.6K) and #1 for new follows (+17). Personal, founder-told, face-forward content converts — make more of it a monthly staple.

✓

Ride the World Cup / sports moment. Position HBG as the spot to watch as summer sports ramp up — a natural draw for groups and weeknight traffic.

✓

Keep Happy Hour weekly for SEO — and test a small boost. With $0 spent so far, a modest paid boost on a top-performing Facebook post is a low-risk way to test paid growth.
